intro: You've searched for classic car insurance near me, so you're likely looking for cover that properly protects an older or collectible vehicle. Whether it's a weekend classic or a cherished project, you want a broker who understands agreed value, limited mileage and the quirks of insuring a car that isn't your everyday runabout. We introduce you to a UK insurance broker who can discuss your needs and quote you directly.
need_heading: What people searching for classic car insurance near me usually need
need_lead: You want cover that reflects your classic car's true worth and how you actually use it.
needs: You own a classic car and want agreed value cover so there's no argument about its worth if it's written off.
You drive your classic only occasionally and need a limited mileage policy that keeps costs down.
You're restoring a classic and want cover while it's off the road or in pieces.
You're a member of a classic car club and want to know if that helps with your premium.
You want to speak to a broker face to face or by phone who knows classic cars, not a call centre reading a script.
context_heading: Why agreed value and limited mileage matter for classic cars
context: Classic car insurance often works differently from standard car cover. Agreed value means you and the insurer settle on the car's value before the policy starts, so there's no dispute later. Limited mileage policies are common because many classics cover low annual mileage, and that can be reflected in the premium.

Insurance brokers in the UK must be authorised by the FCA or be appointed representatives of an authorised firm. You can check them on the FCA register. Many brokers also belong to the British Insurance Brokers' Association (BIBA), and some hold Chartered status from the Chartered Insurance Institute. Brokers must understand your demands and needs, explain key policy features and exclusions, and tell you how they are paid.
tell_heading: What to tell iComply when you enquire
tell: Tell us the make, model and year of your classic car so we can introduce you to a broker who knows that type of vehicle.
Let us know if you want agreed value cover and whether you have a recent valuation or photographs.
Mention your estimated annual mileage and how you use the car, such as weekend drives or shows.
Tell us if you're a member of a classic car club, as some brokers may take that into account.
Let us know if the car is modified from standard, as that can affect cover.
Tell us your preferred way to be contacted and whether you want a face-to-face meeting with a local broker.
questions: Will the policy be on an agreed value basis, and what do you need from me to set that value?
What limited mileage options do you offer, and how do you verify mileage?
Are there any exclusions for modifications or track use?
Do you offer cover for a car undergoing restoration?
How do you handle claims, and can I use my own repairer?
What is your complaint handling process, and are you authorised by the FCA?

faqs.q: Do I need an agreed value policy for my classic car?
faqs.a: If your classic is worth more than a standard market value would reflect, agreed value avoids disputes. It sets the payout in advance, so you know where you stand.

faqs.q: Will limited mileage save me money?
faqs.a: Many classic car policies offer lower premiums for limited mileage because the car is used less. You'll need to estimate your annual mileage accurately.

faqs.q: Does club membership help with insurance?
faqs.a: Some brokers may offer discounts or specialist schemes for members of recognised classic car clubs. It's worth mentioning your membership when you enquire.

faqs.q: Can I insure a classic car that's off the road for restoration?
faqs.a: Yes, specialist policies exist for cars under restoration, often covering fire and theft. Ask the broker about the level of cover available while work is in progress.
